page.layout: One printed block only: a rotated strip of parchment or paper on the right side of the scan bearing a large ornamental inscription running vertically (reading from bottom to top), with a decorative initial at the top. Left of it a library label (Biblioteca Nazionale Centrale V. E. II, Roma, shelf marks 1 6 A 38) pasted on the book cover. Not part of the printed text.
page.notes: The scan shows a rotated fragment with a large decorated inscription in black letter-style capitals, reading vertically, apparently "SAT... IN ... SANCTUS..."-like lettering but not legibly readable as running text: [illegible, ~12 letters]. The library label (NAZIONALE / BIBLIOTECA CENTRALE / ROMA, shelf number 1 6 A 38) and the dark object at lower left are not printed text and are omitted from the transcription.
